real_qa.q: What are the dates and duration of the 2025 Veeam Community Hackathon?
real_qa.r: The 2025 Veeam Community Hackathon runs from December 8th at 9 a.m. Eastern time (15:00 Central European time) until December 13th at the same time. This is the first year the hackathon spans five full days, compared to one day in the first year and three days in the second year, giving participants a whole work week to collaborate on their projects.

real_qa.q: What is the signup deadline for the 2025 Veeam Community Hackathon?
real_qa.r: Signup for the 2025 Veeam Community Hackathon closes on November 17th. Participants can sign up at vmhackathon.com/sign-up to register for the event.

real_qa.q: What Veeam products are included in the provided lab environments for the 2025 hackathon?
real_qa.r: The lab environment will include Veeam Backup and Replication version 12, Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365, Veeam ONE, Service Provider Console, and Enterprise Manager, along with a hypervisor and virtual machines for backup practice. Version 13 will not be available as it won't be ready in time for the lab environment.
real_qa.requete: Veeam Hackathon 2025 lab products VBR VB365

real_qa.q: Why did Veeam extend the 2025 Community Hackathon to five days instead of three?
real_qa.r: The five-day duration was extended because creating a product in just one or three days is a very short period, and it doesn't allow enough time for participants to work on projects outside their normal work schedules. Community members repeatedly requested a longer event, saying they wished it was longer and wanted more time to collaborate with their teams.
real_qa.requete: Veeam Hackathon five days why extended 2025

real_qa.q: What past Veeam Hackathon projects have become lasting community tools or products?
real_qa.r: In year one, a team created a Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 best practices checker whose logic was later used by Jonathan to build an as-built report. Another team worked on Veeam ONE visualizers and Veeam Backup and Replication REST API and PowerShell helpers. In year two, teams created data visualization dashboards using either Veeam Service Provider Console or Veeam ONE.
real_qa.requete: Veeam Hackathon winning projects best practices checker

real_qa.q: Who are the key Veeam product experts mentioned as accessible through the hackathon?
real_qa.r: Key Veeam experts accessible through the hackathon include Jorge De La Cruz (now director of AI reporting with Veeam ONE), Karin Bissett (who worked on VB365), Michael K (who works on Kasten), and Eric Doherty (providing lab environments). These are high-level product specialists who normally have limited accessibility but work directly with hackathon teams.
real_qa.requete: Veeam hackathon product experts Jorge De La Cruz

guest.bio_context: Maurice initiated the idea for the Veeam Community Hackathon in February 2023 and reached out to Jonah to create a bigger community event. He has been instrumental in organizing all three years of the hackathon, expanding it from one day to three days to now five days, with the goal of bringing the Veeam community together and providing direct access to Veeam product management and product strategy teams.
